newer_changes_search: Searched msme1connect.up.gov.in and the web; read the UP Budget 2026-27 highlights. No official 2026 change found. Third-party pages mention a four-year interest subsidy, phase 2 loans and an own contribution of 10% to 15%, none confirmed by an official source I could read.

findings.note: "Interest-free" comes straight from the portal and budget, but third parties describe a 100% interest subsidy for four years and an own contribution. I could not confirm either.
findings.suggestion: Find the guideline and add the interest-free period and own share.

findings.note: The clause is generic and does not name PMEGP, but PMEGP is a central loan subsidy scheme, so the relation holds and the present-tense note matches it.
The field asks about the past 5 years, which is wider than "availing". Uncertain confidence stops this hard-failing anyone.
"Youth of the state" only implies residence.
findings.suggestion: Replace with a clause from the guideline when found.
